scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @trading/api" "npm run dev -w @trading/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @trading/types && npm run build -w @trading/shared
scripts.e2e:servers: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -s first -n api,web "npm run dev:e2e -w @trading/api" "npm run dev:e2e -w @trading/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @trading/api && npm run build -w @trading/web
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
